items.name: Kenmore Mini A 2024
items.information:
**This is a short competition with only three events. It is in series with [Kenmore Mini B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KenmoreMiniB2024) and [Kenmore Mini C](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KenmoreMiniC2024), which means that you may only sign up and compete in *one*  of the three competitions.**

Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a **maximum of two guests each**. Spectators are also only permitted as companions of competitors.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KenmoreMiniA2024#37795-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

[![Image description](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/published/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)

items.name: Mid Summer Madness Cape Town 2024

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.details: School hall and entrance hall for registration

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below.

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more!

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOpen2024#38590-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOpen2024#38591-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación de la categoría, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

***
# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English 

Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOpen2024#38590-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaOpen2024#38591-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
(BR) **Bem-vindos à segunda competição oficial de Morro Reuter!**
Enquanto a maioria das pessoas viaja às praias no verão, a ideia de trazer a população cubista para um lugar calmo e tranquilo na Serra Gaúcha deu origem ao Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024!

A oferta dessa competição é para aproveitar o período de férias longe do stress e tumulto das praias e grandes centros urbanos, trazendo desafios em Gincana interativa, com atividades que desenvolvam o trabalho em equipes e a melhor interação entre os competidores, especialmente crianças do Sul do Brasil.

Nos vemos lá!


(EN) **Welcome to the second official competition in Morro Reuter!**
While most people travel to the beach during the summer, the idea of bringing the speedcubing community to a quiet and peaceful place in tthe Gaucho highlands gave birth to *Morro Reuter em Colônia 2024*!

The proposition of this competition is to take advantage of the holiday season, far from the stress and chaos of the beaches and great urban centres, bringing challenges in an interactive contest, with activities that develop teamwork and the best interaction among the competitors, especially the children from Southern Brazil.

See you there!

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information:
We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.

Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww
If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM.

If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

items.information:
This is the 10th WCA competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The competition is open to all persons from all countries.

**Note**: there is a maximum limit of ten competitors in the 3x3x3 multiblind event, on a first-come, first-served basis. If you register for multiblind after the ten slots have been filled you will be placed on a waiting list in case anybody deletes their registration later.

There will be certificates and medals for all competitors in top 3 of an event.

================

Ovo je 10. WCA takmičenje u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Takmičenje je otvoreno za sve osobe iz svih zemalja.

**Napomena**: može biti maksimalno deset takmičara u 3x3x3 multiblind disciplini, po principu „prvi dođe, prvi uslužen“. Ako se registruje za multiblind nakon što je deset mjesta popunjeno, bit ćete stavljeni na listu čekanja, i vraćeni sa iste u slučaju da neko kasnije izbriše svoju registraciju.

Za sve takmičare u prva 3 mjesta biće dodeljeni sertifikati i medalje.

# Bienvenidos al Mexican Championship 2023

¡Bienvenidos a la página oficial del **Mexican Championship 2023**, el campeonato de speedcubing más grande de México! Estamos emocionados de recibir a todos los competidores y entusiastas del speedcubing en este gran evento.

El campeonato incluirá una serie de emocionantes competencias y actividades para participantes de todos los niveles. Desde los principiantes hasta los cuberos experimentados, habrá algo para todos. ¡Prepárate para desafiar tus habilidades y conocer a otros amantes del cubo!

Welcome to the official website of the Mexican Championship 2023, the largest speedcubing championship in Mexico! We are excited to welcome all competitors and speedcubing enthusiasts to this grand event.

# Event Schedule
The championship will feature a series of exciting competitions and activities for participants of all levels. From beginners to experienced cubers, there will be something for everyone. Get ready to challenge your skills and meet other cube lovers!

# Rules and Regulations
Make sure to review the official WCA rules and regulations before the championship. This will help you be prepared and ensure that your attempts are valid. You can find the rules in the official [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkpWIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d21635fc0f5cbe802272c9c1169d1a241d81b7bf/394771855_661572126079922_8082539372510634594_n.jpg)
Έφτασε επιτέλους η στιγμή που περίμενε τόσα χρόνια όλη η Ελληνική Speedcubing Κοινότητα! 
Το 2023 βάλαμε στόχο και πετύχαμε να απογειώσουμε το Cubing στην Ελλάδα! 
Και τώρα να ‘μαστε, μετά από τη σειρά των τεσσάρων "Road to Nationals" Opens μέσα στο 2023 σε τέσσερα διαφορετικά σημεία της χώρας, σε κλίμα γιορτινό και με όλες τις τιμές που πρέπει, να διοργανώνουμε τα πρώτα GREEK NATIONALS στο Speedcubing! 
Mε μεγάλη χαρά σας καλούμε, μικρούς και μεγάλους, Cubers και Θεατές στη γιορτή του Cubing, τη δική μας γιορτή, για να περάσουμε τρεις υπέροχες μέρες!

Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το εθνικό πρωτάθλημα του 2023. 

Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)


The moment the entire Greek Speedcubing Community has been waiting for so many years has finally arrived!
In 2023 we set a goal and succeeded in boosting Cubing in Greece!
And now, after a series of four "Road to Nationals Opens" in four different locations of the country, in a festive atmosphere and with all due honors befitting the occasion, here we stand organizing the first GREEK NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP in Speedcubing!
It is with great pleasure that we invite you, young and old, Cubers and Spectators to the celebration of Cubing, to our celebration, to spend three beautiful days!

New Zealand Nationals 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, New Zealand Nationals 2023 will crown the National Champions in 16 WCA official events, over the course of 3 days.

# 🇺🇾
Límite de competidores: 40.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35967-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35968-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor descalificandolo de la ronda en cuestión, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35967-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2023#35968-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, as per regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition's website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

**ATENÇÃO**
Essa competição será realizada de uma forma diferente das demais, nela você terá que escolher um evento entre os seguintes para participar:

3x3 ou 2x2
4x4 ou OH
Pyraminx ou Skewb
5x5 ou Square-1

Você não pode competir em dois destes eventos ao mesmo tempo, se você se inscrever em dois deles, levaremos em conta como se você tivesse escolhido aquele com menos participantes. Ou seja, se a Modalidade A tiver 10 inscritos e a B, 5, e você se inscrever nos dois, nós excluiremos a sua inscrição da Modalidade A.

Você não precisa se inscrever em todas as modalidades. Se não desejar participar de nenhuma das duas que acontecerem em determinado momento, não precisa se inscrever em nenhuma. Caso deseje alterar seus eventos, deve contactar os Delegados ou Organização.

Quaisquer outras dúvidas, favor contatar os delegados.

**PLEASE NOTE**
This competition will be run in a different way to the others, you will have to choose an event from the following to take part in:

3x3 or 2x2
4x4 or OH
Pyraminx or Skewb
5x5 or Square-1

You can't compete in two of these events at the same time. If you sign up for two of them, we'll take it into account as if you'd chosen the one with fewer participants. In other words, if Event A has 10 entrants and Event B has 5, and you sign up for both, we will exclude your entry from Event A.

You don't have to sign up for all Events. If you don't want to take part in either of the two taking place at any given time, you don't need to register for either. If you want to change your events, you must contact the Delegates or the Organization team.

If you have any other questions, please contact the delegates

**AOS NOVATOS:** Por favor, enviar um email para [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) ou trazer um documento com foto, data de nascimento e nome completo para fins de completação do processo de registro.

**FOR NEWCOMERS:** Please send an email to [Cubo Mágico Bahia](bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) or bring an ID that contains a photo, date of birth and full name to complete the registration process.

Inscrição de competidor: R$ 25,00

**TAMBÉM TEREMOS AS CATEGORIAS JUVENIS, NAS QUAIS PREMIAREMOS O MELHOR DE CADA MODALIDADE COM MENOS DE 16 ANOS**

REGISTRO
A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante;
Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro.
Há um limite de 40 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com um dos Delegados através do e-mail.

REGISTRATION

Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned

É com grande alegria que anunciamos o retorno do Capivara!

A partir desse ano, pretendemos trabalhar com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
It is in great excitement that we announce the return of Capivara!

From this year on, we intend to work with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

#### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca!

Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe.

Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt".

---

#### Warsaw Cube Masters returns!
We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition.

Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.

items.information:
##### 🇧🇷
O **Pé Vermelho 2023** é um campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar:

* Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register).
* As inscrições vão até o dia **20/10/2023**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes.
* Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará.
* É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.
* O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição.
* Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
* Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento!
* Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande seus questionamentos para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores!
* Divirta-se!

---

##### 🇺🇸
**Pé Vermelho 2023** is an **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate:

* All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register) tab.
* Registration closes on **10/20/2023**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies.
* Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating.
* All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
* The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition.
* If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE).
* There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
* All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in.
* If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers!
* Have fun!

---

items.information:
NZ North Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2023 is the last regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

## Pickering Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Pickering Fall A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFallA2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2023
items.information:
## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2023!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering as there is lots of information which will be new to you, even if you are an experienced competitor.

##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#32058-guests-spectators-and-media) tab.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2023, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2023 t-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your t-shirt size.**

**Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only; the fee must be paid at the competition. We accept cash or card payments.

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2023#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by *9th October 2023*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. There are no qualifications in 3x3, 2x2, Pyraminx, or Skewb, so **newcomers will be able to compete in these events only**.

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2023). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2023.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español 

Hay un límite de 100 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29292-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#29293-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* A las **PERSONAS QUE VIAJEN DESDE LEJOS** se les recomienda leer [Alojamiento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2023#31708-alojamiento-accommodation).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.

This competition features a 30 minute cumulative time limit for 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7 all together. This means that you have a combined total of 30 minutes to complete your 5x5, 6x6, and 7x7 solves (you can sign up for any combination of the 3). You can choose to do the events in any order, but you must finish an event's average (or DNS the rest) before moving on to the next event. Please review regulation [#A1a2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A1a2) if you wish to compete in either 5x5, 6x6, or 7x7. There will also be a 25 minute cumulative time limit for 3x3 Blindfolded.

The competition will take place in Meeting Rooms #1-3 in the RPAC.

## Appleby Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Fall A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebyFallA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## No Food or Drink

Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (EN)

### Registration Reminders

Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. 

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

For new competitors, this video may help with competing. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (FR)

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type " favoris ", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. 

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées et les inscriptions comportant plus de quatre (4) épreuves ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.


### Liste de diffusion

Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions dans le sud de l'Ontario et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

¡Speed Cubing Fest 2023: Despierta al Competidor en ti!

¡Amantes del desafío y los colores vibrantes!

Te invitamos al emocionante Torneo de Speed Cubing, donde la pasión por los rompecabezas y las nuevas experiencias se unen en una jornada llena de giros y vueltas. ¿Eres un novato listo para descubrir tu potencial? ¿Un competidor inactivo en busca de un nuevo reto? ¿Un experimentado de los cubos ansioso por llevar al límite tus habilidades? ¡Este es tu momento!

Ven a superar el desafío que te espera en la ciudad de los pastes.

Speedcubing Fest Pachuca 2023 es una competencia oficial de la WCA y todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

Lovers of challenge and vibrant colors!

We invite you to the exciting Speed Cubing competition, where the passion for puzzles and new experiences come together in a journey full of twists and turns. Are you a newbie ready to discover your potential? An inactive competitor looking for a new challenge? An experienced cuber eager to push your skills to the limit? This is your moment!

Come meet the challenge that awaits you in the city of pastes.

Speedcubing Fest 2023 is an official WCA competition and all the competitors must be familiarized with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Appleby Summer 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Summer A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebySummerA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## No Food or Drink

Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

# 🇺🇾
Límite de competidores: 40.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31648-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31649-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor descalificandolo de la ronda en cuestión, de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31648-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoWinterOpen2023#31649-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, as per regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition's website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
Välkomna till Gotland Open 2023, den första WCA-tävlingen på Gotland!
Tävlingen hålls på Gangvide Farm på Gotlands östkust ca 1 mil söder om Ljugarn. Gangvide farm är ett mysigt ställe där man kan äta färska ägg till frukost och ta ett dopp i ån!
Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 
Det blir en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla 17 WCA-grenar.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information, speciellt fliken "resa".
*Om du inte tävlar i 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD behöver du inte närvara under lördagen*


-----

Welcome to Gotland Open 2023, the first WCA competition on the island of Gotland!
The competition is held at Gangvide Farm on the east coast of Gotland about 10 km south of Ljugarn. Gangvide Farm is a cozy place where you can eat fresh eggs for breakfast and even take a swim in the river!
Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.
It's a 2,5 day competition with all 17 WCA events.

Please read all the information tabs because they contain valuable information, especially the travel tab.
*If you are not competing in 4x4 BLD / 5x5 BLD you do not need to be present during Saturday.*

A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante;
Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição para as modalidades 2x2 e 3x3, no valor de R$ 40,00;
Há um limite de 40 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (jvinicius@worldcubeassociation.org).

REGISTRATION
The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name;
Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will be accepted on the day of the competition for 2x2 and 3x3 events at the cost of R$ 40,00;
There will be a limit of 40 competitors.
For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br)

items.name: 24 Hours in Flen 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Flen! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken **koncept**. Notera också att en sängplats (vandrarhemsstandard) över natten samt frukost ingår i anmälningsavgiften, i samma hus som tävlingen genomförs i.

--

A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Flen! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information, especially the **concept** tab. Also note that a hostel style bed and breakfast is included in the registration fee, in the same house as the competition will take place in.

> Herzlich willkommen zu einer weiteren Side Event Competition in Deutschland!
Fühlt euch herzlich eingeladen an euren liebsten Side Events teilzunehmen und vielleicht sogar die Chance zu nutzen euch noch für verbleibende Disziplinen der German Nationals zu qualifizieren.
Wir freuen uns über alle Teilnehmer die genau so viel Spaß an vielen Runden von interessanten Events haben, wie wir!
Bis bald in Laudenbach!
Euer Orgateam


Welcome to another side event competition in Germany! 
We invite you to compete in your favourite side events and maybe even take your chance at qualifying for German Nationals in events you haven't yet. 
We are looking forward to anyone that enjoys many rounds of interesting events as much as we do!
See you soon in Laudenbach!
Your organization team

items.information:
- This competition takes place on a Sunday. Please plan accordingly. 

- Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a **maximum of one guest each**. Spectators are also only permitted as companions of competitors.

- While the competition takes place in the main floor, you are welcome to sit in the upper area. The kitchen, however, is off limits.

- Please take the time to read the Parking tab if you decide to register. There is limited parking space in front of the venue, but there is space nearby so you should know how to navigate your way to the competition.

- Keep in mind that Multi-Blind takes place at the beginning of the competition, so if you decide to arrive during the event, please be mindful to be quiet until all competitors have finished.


This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). items.information:
Пожалуйста, смотрите наш Инстаграм аккаунт(https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Вся информация и новости по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме.

1. Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей.

2. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец.

---

После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни).

#### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. 

---

Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады.

1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес.

2. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді.

---

Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде).

#### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет.

---

Please see our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link).  All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram.

 1. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings.

 2. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them.

---

 After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site.  This means that your application has been accepted.  If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes.  Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder.  If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted.  If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends).

#### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

NZ South Island Championship 2023 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ South Island Championship 2023 is the first regional championship of 2023 in the lead up to Nationals later in 2023.

## Pickering Side Events 2023

Cubing on the Canada Day long weekend! As we celebrate our country and communities, Canada Day is also an important opportunity to reflect on the historical and ongoing colonization and erasure of Indigenous Peoples on the lands we now call Canada. This competition will be held on the Treaty and traditional territory of the Mississaugas of Scugog Island First Nation and Williams Treaties signatories of the Mississauga and Chippewa Nations.

All proceeds from this competition will be donated to the [Indian Residential School Survivors Society](https://www.irsss.ca) and [Woodland Cultural Centre](https://woodlandculturalcentre.ca).

## Side Events

This competition has "side events", which does _not_ include the standard 3x3x3 Cube event. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&show_registration_status=on) if this competition is not suitable for you.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:

Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

A warm welcome to final competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2023! More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

venue.name: BMG World
venue.address: South Africa, 28 Droste Cres, Droste Park, Johannesburg, 2094

items.information:
CubingZA is excited to announce South Africa's 2023 National Championship. Compete against South Africa's fastest speedcubers and break some records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/216560-cubingza-national-championship-2023#/) page.


# COMPETING

This is an open championship - meaning anyone is free to compete. All WCA events except FMC* will be held, with winners in each event being declared the 2023 South African Champion for that event.


# SPECTATORS

Competitors are allowed to bring up to 2 guests as spectators. Spectators attend for free.


# VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video.

Parents and spectators are welcome to help out with volunteer tasks as well.


# SPONSORS

Massive thanks to the following sponsors, without whom this competition would not be happening.
BMG, who are generously providing their venue at BMG World for the competition, and making Nationals in Joburg a reality.
Speecubes.co.za and CubeCo, South Africa's local cube stores, who will be sponsoring prize money and store vouchers for the competition's winners.
InsightEdge (Pty) Ltd. has also generously offered to sponsor further prize money towards the winners and podium finishers.

*\*A separate FMC Championship will be held at a later date. This championship will take place simultaneously in multiple locations (CPT, JHB and DBN) to minimise travel requirements.*

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.name: Swedish Championship 2023
items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2023! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2023!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2023).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

venue.details: Salomonkatu main entrance facing the metro station

items.information:
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.
Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.**
You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 25 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 24:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one.

Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.
Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.**
Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 25 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 24:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

items.name: LSP Hverdagskubing Mai 2023

venue.name: LSP
venue.details: Stort rosa bygg. Inngang fra Østerdalsgata. 1. etg med LSP Beachflagg utenfor.

items.information:
Hjertelig velkommen til vår andre hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo.
Kveldens konkurranse har et veldig spesielt opplegg, der hver deltaker har 18 minutter i total løsningstid til å gjennomføre alle sine løsninger. Det er deltageren selv som på forhånd velger hvilke grener man vil delta i og bruke sine 18 minutter på. Konkurransen foregår mandag kveld og varer i tilsammen ca 4 timer og du kan delta i maks 5 grener.

Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. 
Vi håper at både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. 

Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser framover og se hvilket format som funker. 
Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. 

Lokalet er har minimalt med tilskuerplass, så det er fint hvis antall gjester er så lavt som mulig.

Konkurransen er sponset av NORDICUBE og SLOAP.

--------------------
Welcome to the second edition of LSP Hverdagskubing in Oslo. This competitions has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves. The competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, that each competitor can choose a maximum of five (5) events to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a Monday, lasts only approx. 4 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Hverdagskubing") so you don't miss any important information.

We are based in a small venue in the center of Oslo where the LSPcubers tend to have cube meetings.
We hope that both experienced and new speedcubers in Oslo want to join these local competitions.

We will create monthly competitions in the future and see which format works.
The aim is to start the Oslo League in the autumn, where we will choose a winner based on the results of several small competitions throughout the autumn and winter.

The venue has limited space for guests. Please bring as few guests as possible.

The competition is sponsored by NORDICUBE and SLOAP.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch "Wiener Frühling 2023" als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga und Felix Strasser und wird delegiert von Bence Barát, Emma Beranová und Viktor Kalmar. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce "Wiener Frühling 2023" as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, David Dinh, Dániel Varga, Felix Strasser and is delegated by Bence Barát, Emma Beranová and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

items.name: National Capital Region B 2023
items.information:
### (EN)
## NCR 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [National Capital Region A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/en) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, you may want to look at the [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

For new competitors, this video may help with competing. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

### (FR)
## Série NCR 2023

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec [National Capital Region A 2023] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NationalCapitalRegionA2023). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à *une* de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée.

## Liste de diffusion

Nous sommes conscients de la demande extrêmement élevée de compétitions en Ontario. Nous travaillons dur pour répondre à cette demande et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement des compétitions plus grandes et plus nombreuses. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les médias sociaux et/ou [joindre notre liste de diffusion] (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. Nous vous remercions de votre patience pendant cette période où nous nous efforçons de faire face à la croissance passionnante de la communauté du cube.

## Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les concurrents doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition, vous pouvez consulter le [Tutoriel de la compétition de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/files/WCA_Competition_Tutorial.pdf).

Pour les nouveaux concurrents, cette vidéo peut les aider à participer à la compétition. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww&t=2s

Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

## Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: CubingZA Cape Cubes Autumn 2023

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)
venue.address: 18 Lente St, Kirstenhof, Cape Town, 7945, South Africa

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the second Cape Town competition for 2023. This competition will take on a "Big & Weird" theme on Saturday, with bigger NxN cubes and some side events not often held in Cape Town, with a more familiar event structure on Sunday! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/208588-cubingza-cape-cubes-autumn-2023/#/) page.

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information:
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.
Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.**
You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one.

Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.
Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.**
Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.
